items.x: When you succeed with style on a defend against a close-combat attack, you may give the attacker a Dazed boost instead of one for yourself.
+2 to overcome with Athletics in a chase across rooftops or a similar precarious place.
Move two zones for free instead of one when nothing is in the way.
+2 to create an advantage with Burglary to escape a location.
You need not be present to provide active opposition to someone trying to beat a security system you put in place or worked on.
You can use Burglary in place of Contacts when dealing with other thieves and burglars.
Whenever someone initiates a conflict against you in an area where you have a network of contacts, use Contacts instead of Notice to determine turn order.
+2 to create an advantage when you plant vicious rumors about someone else.
You can use Contacts instead of Provoke to create advantages based on the fear your reputation inspires.
You don't ever have to spend a fate point to declare that you have the proper tools for a particular job using Crafts.
When you succeed with style at a repair, you may immediately give the object a new situation aspect for free.
When you use Crafts against an inanimate object, you get weapon:2 against it.
+2 to create a Deceive advantage against someone who has believed one of your lies already during this session.
You can use Deceive in place of Provoke to make mental attacks.
Whenever you meet someone new, you can spend a fate point to declare that you have met that person before under a different name and identity.
+2 to Drive whenever you are pursuing or being pursued.
You can coax more speed out of your vehicle than seems possible.
When ramming another vehicle, you ignore two shifts of damage.
+2 to all Empathy rolls made to discern or discover lies.
You can use Empathy instead of Notice to determine turn order in a conflict, provided you have had a chance to observe the situation.
Once per session you can reduce someone else's consequence by one level with Empathy.
Whenever someone is about to hit you with a Disarmed situation aspect, spend a fate point to declare you have a backup weapon.
When you succeed with style on a Fight attack and choose to reduce the result by one to gain a boost, you gain a full situation aspect with a free invocation instead.
Once per scene, when you force an opponent to take a consequence, spend a fate point to increase the consequence's severity.
You can use Investigate instead of Empathy to defend against Deceive attempts.
On a successful Investigate roll to eavesdrop, you can reveal or discover an additional aspect.
Once per scene, spend a fate point and roll Investigate to discover an aspect about each person or object in the scene.
Spend a fate point to use Lore in place of any other skill for one roll, as long as you can justify having read about the action.
You can use Lore as a defense against Provoke attempts, if you can justify your ability to overcome your fear.
Choose a field of specialization. You get +2 to Lore rolls relating to that field.
You can use Notice in place of Empathy to learn the aspects of a target through observation.
You have an almost preternatural capacity for detecting danger; your Notice works unimpeded by conditions like total concealment or darkness.
You can use Notice instead of Shoot to make quick, reactive shots that do not involve careful aim.
You can use Physique to defend against Provoke attempts that rely on intimidation.
+2 to Physique rolls made to create advantages on an enemy by wrestling or grappling with them.
Once per session, at the cost of a fate point, you can reduce the severity of a moderate physical consequence to mild, or erase a mild one.
You can use Provoke to defend against Fight attacks, until you take stress in the conflict.
You can use Provoke in place of Empathy to learn a target's aspects by bullying them until they reveal one.
When you create an advantage on an opponent using Provoke, you can use your free invocation to become the target of that character's next action.
Twice per session, you may upgrade a boost to a full situation aspect with a free invocation.
+2 to Rapport when you are delivering an inspiring speech in front of a crowd.
If you are in an area where you are popular and well-liked, you can use Rapport in place of Contacts.
You can use Resources instead of Rapport in any situation where ostentatious displays of material wealth might aid your cause.
You get an additional free invoke when you create advantages with Resources, provided they describe a monetary return.
Twice per session, you may take a boost representing a windfall or influx of cash.
During a Shoot attack, spend a fate point and declare a specific condition you want to inflict on a target; if you succeed you also place it as a situation aspect.
You can use Shoot instead of Notice to determine turn order in any physical conflict where shooting quickly would be useful.
Once per conflict, stack an additional free invoke on an advantage you have created to represent the time you take to aim.
+2 to any Stealth roll to blend into a crowd.
Once per scene, you can vanish while in plain sight by spending a fate point.
Provided you are in darkness or shadow, you can use Stealth to defend against Shoot attacks from enemies at least one zone away.
You can choose to ignore a mild or moderate consequence for the duration of the scene.
+2 to defend against Provoke attacks specifically related to intimidation and fear.
Use Will instead of Physique on any overcome rolls representing feats of strength.
